conclusion.rationale: The immutable .b64 file itself contains a literal ellipsization marker. Removing only punctuation would leave marker letters that are valid base64 alphabet, so permissive sanitization could silently change decoded bytes. The job contract requires a boundary when payload corruption is proven.
